+
+def paper_xy(u: float, v: float) -> tuple[float, float]:
+    return (PAPER_FAR_X - (v + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX,
+            PAPER_LEFT_Y - (u + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX)
+

+def pixel_pose(point, q=Q_DOWN):
+    u, v, pressure_mm = point
+    x, y = paper_xy(u, v)
+    z = SURFACE_Z - pressure_mm / 1000.0
+    return np.array([x, y, z, *q], dtype=float)

+def evenly_spaced(a, b, max_step_m):
+    a = np.asarray(a, dtype=float)

+    end_high = points[-1].copy(); end_high[2] = 0.070
+    lift = evenly_spaced(points[-1], end_high, 0.035 * DT)
+    return np.vstack([lower, trace, lift])
+

+def draw_one(r, index, park_after=True):
+    stroke = STROKES[index]
+    first = pixel_pose(stroke[0])
+    go_xyz(r, [first[0], first[1], 0.070], speed=0.095,
+           tag=f'main_{index+1:02d}_approach')
+    actions = main_contact_rows(stroke)
+    result = r.submit('ee_pose', actions, dt=DT,
+                      cameras=['canvas_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'], video='both',
+                      video_fps=10, note=f'main sheet stroke {index+1}/10')
+    out = RUNS / f'main_{index+1:02d}'
+    result.save(str(out))
+    print('main stroke',index+1,'rows=',len(actions),'pose=',
+          np.round(result.meta['proprio']['now'][7:10],4),
+          'IK_failures=',sum(p['ik_failures'] for p in result.meta['plan']),
+          'saved=',out)
+    if park_after:
+        go_xyz(r, [WELL_XY[0], WELL_XY[1], 0.100], speed=0.095,
+               tag=f'main_{index+1:02d}_park')
+        obs = r.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],
+                        video='frames')
+        from PIL import Image
+        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        for cam, frame in obs.last.items():
+            Image.fromarray(frame).save(out / f'parked_{cam}.png')
+    return result
+
+
+def practice_line(r, x0, x1, y, z, label):
+    q = Q_DOWN
+    hi = np.array([x0,y,0.100,*q],float)
+    low0 = hi.copy(); low0[2] = z
+    low1 = low0.copy(); low1[0] = x1
+    high1 = low1.copy(); high1[2] = 0.100
+    current = now_pose(r)
+    rows = np.vstack([
+        evenly_spaced(current,hi,0.095*DT),
+        evenly_spaced(hi,low0,0.035*DT),
+        evenly_spaced(low0,low1,0.020*DT),
+        evenly_spaced(low1,high1,0.035*DT),
+    ])
+    res = r.submit('ee_pose',rows,dt=DT,cameras=['practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],
+                   video='both',video_fps=10,note=label)
+    res.save(str(RUNS / label))
